reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333! This is the short-term fix from #198. Teammates get their tools from `runAgent` with `isAsync: true` and without `useExactTools`, so they always go through `filterToolsForAgent`, and sync subagents a teammate spawns run in its context and are filtered too. We ran the tests: the teammate case fails with `main`'s `agentToolUtils.ts` and passes with yours.

As with #203, we pushed a small commit on top: merged `main`, removed the added comments in the code and the test, and added a CHANGELOG entry. Approving and merging. Thanks again!
